_comment: Single source of truth for all MCC parameters. Drives CLI, validation, prompts, widget, and tests.

icGpuCount.description: GPUs allocated to the inference component

icMemorySize.description: Memory in MB for the inference component

maxLoras.description: Maximum concurrent LoRA adapters in GPU memory

includeBenchmark.description: Include SageMaker AI Benchmarking scripts (do/benchmark, do/optimize). Workload configuration is specified at runtime via --workload flag.

benchmarkRequestCount.description: Total number of benchmark requests to send

benchmarkS3OutputPath.description: S3 URI for benchmark results output

skipPrompts.description: Skip interactive prompts and use configuration from other sources

autoPrompt.description: Fill defaults, prompt only for missing required values

force.description: Overwrite existing output directory without prompting

noBuild.description: Use stock DLC image directly — skip Dockerfile/build/push generation

modelFormat.description: Model serialization format (pkl, joblib, json, model, ubj, keras, h5, SavedModel)

roleArn.description: IAM role ARN for SageMaker execution

hfToken.description: HuggingFace token (or $HF_TOKEN for env var reference)

hfTokenArn.description: HuggingFace token ARN from Secrets Manager

ngcToken.description: NVIDIA NGC token (or $NGC_API_KEY for env var reference)

ngcTokenArn.description: NVIDIA NGC token ARN from Secrets Manager

endpointInitialInstanceCount.description: Number of instances for the endpoint

endpointVolumeSize.description: ML storage volume size in GB

capacityReservationArn.description: Capacity reservation ARN (FTP or ODCR) for reserved instance deployment

icCpuCount.description: vCPUs allocated to the inference component

asyncS3OutputPath.description: S3 output path for async results

prompt.message: S3 output path for async results?

asyncSnsSuccessTopic.description: SNS topic ARN for success notifications

asyncSnsErrorTopic.description: SNS topic ARN for error notifications

batchInputPath.description: S3 input path for batch data

batchOutputPath.description: S3 output path for batch results

batchSplitType.description: Input split type: Line, RecordIO, None

icEnv.description: Deploy-time environment variable for inference components (IC_ENV_* prefix), repeatable (e.g. VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN=8192)

smart.description: Enable smart mode (live AWS API calls for MCP servers)

discover.description: Enable discovery mode for MCP servers

offline.description: Run in offline mode (no network calls)
